title: One change item: one line of _build/corpus/changes/<service>.jsonl
description: Written by saalib/feeds.py (see TOOLS-feeds.md, which owns the format). Tier 3: a date and what changed, never current truth. A fact names a change item in change_items by the item's key: the 'id' of a whatsnew row, or '<history_source_id>#<line>' for a history row. Source-specific fields are optional here.

text.description: whatsnew: the whole post text from the API (an index, not evidence)

link.description: history: the first link in the row

history_source_id.description: history: the page snapshot the row comes from

quote.description: history: the table row exactly as written; find_quote matches it in the page snapshot
